model_annotation: The graph displays the training loss over iterations for several models, including a Vanilla model and various versions of SepLLM and StrmLLM. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," ranges from 0 to 140,000, with major gridlines at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, with major gridlines at intervals of 0.1. All models start with a high loss near 3.4 at iteration 0. The Vanilla model (purple line) and the StrmLLM (n=64) model (blue line) exhibit a rapid initial decrease in loss, followed by a slower convergence. The SepLLM (n=64) model (orange line) shows a similar initial drop but converges to a slightly higher loss value than the Vanilla model. The SepLLM (n=64, H) model (green line) and the SepLLM (n=64, H/T) model (red line) follow a similar trajectory, converging to a loss value slightly above 2.5. The SepLLM (n=128) model (dark blue line) starts with a higher loss than the other models and converges to a loss value slightly below 2.5.
